COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
AO No. 350 of 2011
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Present Mr. Lalit Belwal, counsel for 
the appellant/Insurance Company.
Present Mr. Devang Dobhal, proxy 
counsel for Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, counsel 
for the respondent nos. 1 to 4/claimants. 
Present Ms. Rajni Rangwal, proxy 
counsel for Mr. Pawan Mishra, counsel for 
the respondent no. 5/owner.
2. Counsel for the appellant would submit 
that there is specific finding given by the 
Motor Accident Claim Tribunal/Addl. 
District Judge/F.T.C, Tehri Garhwal in Para 
21 of the impugned judgment that at the time 
of accident there was no fitness, permit and 
registration of the offending vehicle owned 
by the respondent no. 5/owner, therefore, the 
Tribunal erred in fixing the liability upon the 
appellant/Insurance Company to pay the 
compensation of ` 23,62,568/-.
3. Counsel for the respondent no. 5 seeks 
and is granted time to apprise herself with the 
facts of the case and law on the point for the 
grounds taken in the appeal. 
4. List this matter on 11.03.2024.
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 03.10.2023
Akash
